The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e2000710ef969c50), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let n ≥ 3, and let (A1, . . . , An, C) be a freely generating Haar tuple in a finite von Neumann algebra (M, τ). For every ε > 0 there are a trace-preserving normal automorphism α of M and a word w ∈ Fn such that, with A′ j = α(Aj), max 1≤j≤n A′ j − Aj < ε, A′ w − C < ε. (5.1) The tuple (A′ 1, . . . , A′ n, C′), where C′ = α(C), is again freely generating Haar. Here the target in the second estimate is the original C; the new completion is C′ = CA∗ w, where Aw is evaluated on the original n-tuple.
